name: US4932811A Well head conductor and/or caisson support system
notes: Patent read in the WHP sweep: Well head conductor and/or caisson support system; assignee Robert Folding (Individual); Published 1990-06-12. Four-pile clamp system around a caisson/conductor giving 360 degree boat access; boat deck and upper/heliport decks supported by the piles, not the caisson. Page read 2026-11-24.
